title: League of Legends Patch 26.16 Notes
overview: Patch 26.16 goes after the bot lane: roaming supports get their quest income throttled, every marksman gains base magic resistance to survive mage bot lanes, and Sundered Sky's grip on AD fighters is loosened with buffs spread across Black Cleaver, Eclipse and Sterak's Gage. Jungle pets scale better off AP and resistances to open the role to mages and tanks, while League Classic adds its ninja trio and Bravery Arena returns on a weekly rotation.
summary: Every ADC now has 33 base MR (up from 30) — mage bot lanes lost their free lane-bully phase.
Support quest stacks burn faster off CS and the out-of-lane XP/gold penalty jumped to -33% until level 5, so roaming supports fall behind hard.
Sundered Sky's healing dropped to 90% base AD + 4% missing health while Black Cleaver, Eclipse, Sterak's Gage and Tiamat all got buffed — the one-item AD fighter build is over.
Poppy is now a tank, not a fighter: less base AD, less bonus AD scaling on Q, more max health scaling and a 16% resist W.
changelogHighlights: League Classic adds Akali, Kennen and Shen with their original ability kits.
Bravery Arena returns on a weekly Wednesday schedule with Bravery and Crowd Favorites queues.
Arena and ARAM: Mayhem augment pools updated, including new Upgrade Sundered Sky and Upgrade Ravenous Hydra augments.
Bot lane rebalanced across supports, marksmen and AD fighter items.

champions.summary: Shield frontloading gutted, W turned into a stronger sustained tool.
champions.details: Her passive shield now scales 10/15/20/25% max health by level instead of a flat 20% and base mana rose to 375, while W's cooldown dropped to 12s at rank 1 with more bonus damage — support Camille loses her early durability, but top lane Camille trades better in extended fights.
champions.name: Camille

champions.summary: Rebuilt from AD bruiser into a tank.
champions.details: Base AD fell to 56 and Q's bonus AD ratio dropped to 75% while its max-health damage and monster cap went up and W's resistances rose to 16%, so building Black Cleaver-style damage is now clearly worse than stacking health and armor.
champions.name: Poppy

champions.summary: Q stacking rebalanced toward lane, away from jungle.
champions.details: Siphoning Strike now grants 4 stacks normally but only 10 on champions, large minions and monsters instead of 3/12 — clearing camps stacks Q noticeably slower, which mostly hurts jungle Nasus.
champions.name: Nasus

champions.summary: True Form attack speed and health growth cut.
champions.details: Health growth dropped to 105 and True Form attack speed now caps at 20% instead of 25%, so late-game Bel'Veth shreds objectives and squishies slower — though a new purple resource bar finally shows Remora stacks.
champions.name: Bel'Veth

champions.details: A Thousand Cuts now heals 67% post-mitigation with a 12-40 (+7% AP) cap instead of 50% and 10-25 (+6.5% AP), giving Gwen far better sustain through poke and extended top lane trades.
champions.name: Gwen

champions.summary: Ultimate hits harder and makes him tankier.
champions.details: Slicing Maelstrom now grants 25/50/75 resistances and deals up to 300/600/900 (+187.5% AP), so diving into a teamfight with R is both safer and considerably more lethal.
champions.name: Kennen

champions.summary: Q base damage up by 15 at all ranks.
champions.details: Conquering Sands now deals 75/95/115/135/155 base damage, which mainly improves Azir's early wave clear and poke before his items come online.
champions.name: Azir

items.details: Healing dropped to 90% base AD (45% ranged) plus 4% missing health instead of 100%/6%, with the Ruby Crystal removed from the recipe for 450 health — the default first item on nearly every AD fighter is no longer an automatic pick.
items.name: Sundered Sky

items.summary: 45 AD now, but ranged users get half the move speed.
items.details: Attack damage rose to 45 while Fervor's move speed splits into 20 melee / 10 ranged, making it a much stronger Sundered Sky alternative for melee bruisers specifically.
items.name: Black Cleaver

items.summary: More max-health damage, slightly smaller shield.
items.details: The proc now deals 8% max health for melee (5% ranged) with a marginally weaker shield, so Eclipse is a better damage-first option against tanky lanes.
items.name: Eclipse

items.summary: Bonus AD conversion up to 50% of base AD.
items.details: The extra attack damage from base AD rose from 45% to 50%, giving bruisers a bit more damage on an item they were already buying for the lifeline shield.
items.name: Sterak's Gage

items.details: Five extra attack speed at both tiers makes the marksman boot noticeably better in the same patch ADCs got base MR — a clear signal to buy them early.
items.name: Berserker's Greaves

items.summary: Bolts hit for 65% AD and more move speed.
items.details: Wind's Fury bolts jumped from 55% to 65% AD with 5% move speed, sharply improving wave clear and teamfight output on crit ADCs like Twitch, Sivir and Kog'Maw.
items.name: Runaan's Hurricane

items.details: Two extra flat magic penetration slightly compensates mages for the ADC magic resistance buff, particularly in mid lane.
items.name: Spellslinger's Shoes

items.summary: Better champion burn, worse jungle clear, costs more.
items.details: Burn now scales 1.5% bonus health against champions but with reduced minion and monster modifiers and a 700g combine cost, so it's better in fights and worse as a clearing item.
items.name: Sunfire Cape

items.details: Five fewer MR makes it a weaker defensive purchase, aimed at reducing how easily mid laners could shrug off magic damage.
items.name: Chainlaced Crushers

items.details: Five extra AD makes the Tiamat power spike stronger for anyone rushing Ravenous or Titanic Hydra.
items.name: Tiamat

systems.summary: Support quest punishes roaming and farming much harder.
systems.details: Stack consumption on CS rose to 18/21 while the out-of-lane minion XP and gold penalty went from -25% until level 3 to -33% until level 5, so supports who leave bot lane to act as a second jungler now pay for it in gold and levels.

systems.summary: Every ADC gets 33 base MR with lower per-level growth.
systems.details: All 27 listed marksmen (plus Tristana, up from 28) move to 33 + 1.1 MR per level from 30 + 1.3, which is a direct early-game answer to mages and enchanters taking over bot lane.

systems.summary: Jungle pets scale off AP, resistances and health.
systems.details: Pet damage now scales 16% AP, 25% bonus armor, 25% bonus MR and 4% bonus health, letting mage and tank junglers clear at a competitive pace instead of being forced into AD bruiser builds.

systems.summary: Hail of Blades loses melee attack speed, gains scaling.
systems.details: Melee attack speed dropped from 120% to 90% while the true damage now scales 12% bonus AD and 10% AP, weakening the early roaming burst pattern the keystone enabled without hurting late-game users.

systems.summary: Fleet Footwork heals for meaningfully more.
systems.details: Healing rose to 15-160 from 10-130, making the sustain keystone a real option again for lane bullies and poke-heavy matchups.

systems.summary: Akali, Kennen and Shen join the mode.
systems.details: The three ninjas arrive with their original kits — Akali's energy-refunding Mark of the Assassin, Kennen's Mark of the Storm stun stacks, and Shen's global Stand United shield — expanding the Classic champion pool.

systems.summary: Gold, Homeguards, turrets and jungle all retuned.
systems.details: Ambient gold starts at 90s with lower minion values, Homeguards no longer exist before 15 minutes with shorter early death timers, turrets gained 500 health while AP damage to them was halved to 20%, and monster health scaling rose to 315% — so early leads matter more but snowballing through structures is slower.

systems.summary: Big balance pass plus new rune options.
systems.details: Tryndamere, Twitch, Blitzcrank, Heimerdinger, Warwick, Katarina and Janna were all cut back while Lux, Soraka, Skarner, Miss Fortune and Veigar were buffed, and eight new energy/AP/regen runes were added alongside placeholder rune power rising to 80%.

systems.summary: Augment pool reworked with two new upgrades.
systems.details: Upgrade Sundered Sky and Upgrade Ravenous Hydra were added, Nature is Healing was rebuilt with per-bush cooldowns, Shark Bait was buffed to 30% missing health damage, and Chain Reaction dropped from Prismatic to Gold — so familiar augment picks need re-evaluating.

systems.summary: Gnar, Rek'Sai and LeBlanc buffed; key augments retuned.
systems.details: Gnar now transforms without a Tired window, Rek'Sai's tunnels reuse almost instantly at max rank, LeBlanc's Q fully refunds cooldown, while Three Sacred Treasures ratios were cut and Now You See Me now spawns a decoy clone.
Every Wednesday players can queue for Bravery Arena, choosing between fully random champions or Crowd Favorites from their owned pool.
